newsitem.title: UK: BoE to launch money market reform plan - FT.
newsitem.headline: BoE to launch money market reform plan - FT.

text.p: The Bank of England is set to announce it will start implementing changes next month in the way it operates in the money market, the Financial Times said on Tuesday.

To cushion the effects on the discount houses, which would lose their intermediary status between the central bank and the money market, the Bank of England would also announce a transition period of up to two years, the FT said.
It added the Bank of England had decided to introduce the money market reforms earlier than expected to avoid market pressure ahead of the upcoming election.
The Bank of England was due to introduce daily gilt sales and repurchase agreements to steer short-term money market rates, the FT said.
The bank published its draft proposals, which are aimed at bringing Britain's money market instruments in line with other EU countries, in December.
